sources.title: epfml/autoTrain: Open Challenge - GitHub
sources.snippet: AutoTrain challenges you to submit optimizers that work reliably on any deep learning task without task-specific tuning. It separates AutoML into (1) fully automatic training of a model and (2) model selection, and tackles the first aspect.
